verdict.stance: Neutral / Core IG Israeli Bank Senior Benchmark
verdict.summary: Core IG CEMBI banking benchmark following its $2.0bn dual-tranche NY-law senior debut in Jan 2026 (4.722% 2029 & 5.252% 2033). 9M26 net profit ILS 6.98bn (14.0% ROE), ultra-clean 0.49% NPLs with massive 292% coverage, and 11.62% CET1; Fitch affirmed A- Stable in Oct 2026.

positives: Fortress reserve coverage: 0.49% NPL ratio backed by 292% NPL coverage and 12bp Q3 cost of risk.
Higher CET1 than Leumi: 11.62% at 3Q26 (+62bp above 11.0% board minimum target).
Liquid $2bn NY-law senior curve (Jan-26) with Fitch A- / S&P BBB+ Stable ratings reaffirmed Oct 2026.
negatives: Sovereign ceiling & geopolitical sensitivity to Israeli macro/fiscal conditions.
Fast 15.4% YoY loan expansion (ILS 553.2bn) plus 50% payout policy (ILS 946m div + ILS 236m buyback in Q3).
Special bank levy and moderating rate environment weigh on 2027 NIM trajectory.

background.business_overview: Israel's second-largest commercial bank with balanced retail, mortgage, SME, and corporate banking market share (~30%).
background.asset_perimeter: Domestic Israeli banking network and international NY/corporate banking unit.
background.ownership_governance: Publicly listed on TASE (POLI) with no controlling shareholder; Bank of Israel regulated.

recent_drivers: Q3/9M 2026 Results: 9M net profit ILS 6,976m, Q3 ILS 2,364m (core flat ex-2025 insurance gain), CET1 11.62%, NPL 0.49% (292% coverage).
Oct-26 Rating Action: Fitch affirmed Long-Term IDR at A- Stable (senior unsecured USD 2029/2033 notes at A-).
Jan-26 Issuance: Priced $2.0bn dual-tranche NY-law senior unsecured ($1B 4.722% Jul-29 & $1B 5.252% Jan-33).
